# Insighto.ai

Insighto.ai is an AI-powered communication platform that enables businesses to create and deploy conversational AI chatbots and voice agents for enhanced customer engagement across multiple channels.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/insighto-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Intent**: Create a new intent in insighto.ai.
- **Create Provider**: Create a new provider.
- **Create Widget**: Create a new widget with specified attributes.
- **Get Contact By ID**: Retrieve details of a specific contact by contact id.
- **Get List Of Contacts**: Fetch a paginated list of contacts.
- **Get List Of Conversations**: Fetch a list of conversations.
- **Get List Of Datasources**: List all existing data sources.
- **Read Contact Custom Field List**: Retrieve a list of custom fields associated with contacts.
- **Read Intents List**: Retrieve a list of all intents.
- **Send Messages To Contacts**: Send messages to a list of contacts in bulk.
